name: shared-frame-import-boundary
goal: Keep shared explorer frames independent of entity-specific panels while preserving source-code modal behavior

evidence: Commit 16ab6fdf6 made ExplorerFrame import an archive reader from EntitySource.svelte. At 86529ba6a, the normal composition test proves history reaches that panel; 634 other Reports cases pass.

The focused Source pair omitted the existing composition suite after changing shared-frame imports. Strengthen its general Entity-pane boundary and require that suite in frame-focused commands; normal Reports verification already owns it.
Sealed red 2ae28d51 at 5dd1dbd5d proves the direct shared-frame pane-import assertion. The original history-separation assertion also fails; archive and modal behavior still pass.

Move the unchanged archive reader and path selector into the existing source-reader store; preserve the component export. Enforce the general Entity-pane boundary in standard composition coverage and frame-focused acceptance.
